title: Zoning text change for Mandatory Inclusionary Housing, Corona, Queens
summary: This resolution approves a zoning text amendment designating a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 47-03 108th Street in Corona, Queens. Combined with a related zoning map change, it would enable a new 13-story building with about 119 apartments, 30 of them income-restricted, plus commercial and community facility space. The City Council held a public hearing on the plan on July 21, 2026.
